description: Production-oriented ASP.NET Core application template with structured logging, security headers, forwarded headers, rate limiting, centralized error handling, cookie authentication, authenticated-by-default routed endpoints, policy-based authorization, and EF Core-ready structure.
releaseNotes: Minor 2.11.0 release of the NetCoreApplicationTemplate dotnet new template. This release publishes the audit-completion v1 contract vectors and strengthens generated applications with unsafe-request antiforgery validation, canonical audit value rendering, normalized actor claims, transactional reconciliation with concurrency guards, and bounded malformed-record queries. Existing unsafe endpoints that intentionally omit antiforgery tokens and consumers that compare stored canonical audit digests require review. The package ID, template identities, short name, supported options, and net10.0 target remain unchanged.
title: .NET Core Application Template
